title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 35
description: Ten questions on Genesis 35: Jacob returns to Bethel, Rachel dies giving birth to Benjamin, and Isaac dies.

questions.text: What did God tell Jacob to do at the start of Genesis 35?
questions.explanation: God said to Jacob, "Arise, go up to Bethel, and live there. Make there an altar to God."

answers.text: Return to Laban in Haran and stay there
Go down into Egypt and live there
Go up to Bethel, live there and make an altar
Build a city at Shechem and live there

questions.text: What did Jacob tell his household to do before going to Bethel?
questions.explanation: Jacob said, "Put away the foreign gods that are among you, purify yourselves, change your garments."

answers.text: Fast for seven days before the journey
Sacrifice the firstborn of their flocks
Leave their tents and cattle behind
Put away their foreign gods and change their garments

questions.text: Where did Jacob hide the foreign gods and the rings?
questions.explanation: They gave Jacob the foreign gods and the rings in their ears, and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.

questions.text: Who was Deborah, who was buried below Bethel?
questions.explanation: Deborah, Rebekah's nurse, died and was buried below Bethel under the oak, which was called Allon Bacuth.

questions.text: Besides a nation and a company of nations, what did God Almighty say would come from Jacob?
questions.explanation: God said, "A nation and a company of nations will be from you, and kings will come out of your body."

questions.text: What name did Rachel give her son as she was dying?
questions.explanation: As her soul was departing, she named him Benoni, but his father named him Benjamin.
Rachel died and was buried on the way to Ephrath, also called Bethlehem.

questions.text: Which son is called Jacob's firstborn in the list of his sons?
questions.explanation: The sons of Leah were Reuben (Jacob's firstborn), Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar and Zebulun.

questions.text: Who were the sons of Zilpah, Leah's servant?
questions.explanation: The sons of Zilpah, Leah's servant, were Gad and Asher.
The days of Isaac were one hundred eighty years. He died old and full of days, and Esau and Jacob buried him.
